tiere.png.prompt:
Flat illustration for the room of a children's library in a learning app for 6- to 10-year-olds, calm modern picture-book style.
Soft pastel colours on warm paper white, a few clear shapes, soft dark-violet outlines (#3B2A6B), matte paper texture, no gradients
except a soft sky, gentle daylight, no harsh shadows. Tall portrait format that will be shown inside an arched doorway: one clear,
friendly motif in the middle and lower part of the image, generous calm space at the top, nothing important at the very edges.
Realistic proportions, animals look like real animals (no clothes, no human poses, no big cartoon eyes). Calm, bright, nothing scary.
Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or signs anywhere in the image. No people, no faces.

Scene: Room 'Animals': a calm meadow at the edge of a light forest. In the lower middle a ginger cat sits in the grass, next to it a brown rabbit, a hedgehog under a bush, a robin on a low branch, a fox peeking from behind a tree trunk at the side, a few butterflies. Soft green and sky blue, warm sunlight.

zahlen-buchstaben-foto.png.prompt:
Photorealistic photograph for a children's learning app (ages 6 to 9), like a calm, high-quality nature or documentary photo.
Natural daylight, soft and friendly, true-to-life colours and proportions, sharp focus on the subject, gentle background blur.
Everything must be anatomically and factually correct (correct number of legs, ears, eyes; real species; real objects).
Bright, calm and safe: nothing scary, no injury, no danger, no darkness. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brands,
no watermarks. People only if the scene needs them: ordinary, diverse, natural, never stereotyped, no recognizable real persons.
Square format (1:1), the subject clearly visible and centred, uncluttered composition.

Wide calm composition with the objects in the centre band of the image so it can be cropped to a 3:2 landscape tile; nothing important near the top or bottom edge.
